reviews.review_description: Last year we used Sustainable Solar Solutions to install our 4kW solar power system and we were incredibly impressed by the service, advice and knowledgeability of the staff and the quality of the materials and workmanship. These are qualities you would expect when making such a large investment but sadly these days most companies miss the mark - not Sustainable Solar Solutions. Since the installation we have received two large payments from our electrical supplier. We couldn't be happier!

What started as one of the most confusing big decisions we have made for some years with our home, became a no brainer very quickly. Steve and his firm SSS were the most honest and forthright of any of the people we spoke to, and they provided the clearest advice, and then the best product for our needs and budget.The installation on our highset home was done extremely promptly, and nothing, nothing was a problem. All paperwork was submitted fast, and his follow-up service has been outstanding, with the few queries that we have had. We were so impressed, we recommended to other family members, and he has since completed installations for my parents, and my brother, to their absolute delight.All 3 installations are performing to, and at times, above their specifications. Steve has gained our trust, and I have only praise for his guidance through product knowledge, product placement and after sales service.Thank you. If we ever move, you're on our list.
Provided a Solar investigation with a Sunny Eye, installed quality Trina panels  & SMA inverter. Were prompt (within 2 weeks of providing revised quote) on time and did an extremely professional job.
